programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Antonov AN-2"
programmes.d: We take you flying in this classic Russian workhorse. Anthony gets hands-on with the revolutionary iPad tablet to show some of the most popular aviation tools available. A look at the future of commercial aviation… but who will be there to fly these things?

programmes.t: The Aviators S2 - "Cessna 195"
programmes.d: Kurtis takes us up in the aircraft that’s a crowd favorite wherever it he takes it. We spend some time with an ever-growing group of people who use their planes as campers and for one week a year, the tower at Oshkosh’s Wittman Regional Airport becomes the busiest on the planet.

programmes.t: The Aviators S3 - "WWII Pilot Training - T-6"
programmes.d: Kurtis earn his wings in a T-6 warbird at Stallion 51 Flight Operations in Kissimmee, FL!

programmes.t: The Aviators S3 - "WWII Training - P-51"
programmes.d: Kurtis takes you back in time to see what it was like for young WWII pilots fly in the legendary fighter, the P-51 Mustang.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Getting to Know Rick O'Shea"
programmes.d: In this episode we get know Larry’s friend Rick O’Shea (Ricochet). Terry and Larry test several different films where bullets are manipulated in order to get an amazing result. They test scenes from Skyfall, Suicide Squad, American Ultra, and The Bear.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Larry's Shadow"
programmes.d: Larry gets sucked into Terry’s dark and mysterious world because Terry wants to test 2 scenes from the 1994 film with Alec Baldwin, The Shadow. Terry will find out if they can save a man trapped in cement shoes, and then they will do a seemly impossible test.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "We Hear Ya!"
programmes.d: Larry and Terry test several requests from viewers. They will test a bunch of crazy scenes from Bad Boys 2, Under Siege, A LIcense to Kill, and Bangkok Dangerous.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "D-Day By Air"
programmes.d: Terry goes back to paratrooper school and will see how difficult it was for soldiers engaging the enemy while parachuting down to safety on D-Day. He will attempt with 3 different weapons to hit several targets while descending from the air.

programmes.t: The 94%
programmes.d: Inside Web3: meet the pioneers, creators and con artists redefining wealth, culture and the future of the internet.

programmes.t: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Crashes"
programmes.d: Join us as we investigate the worst plane, train and ship disasters of all time.

programmes.t: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Man Made Disasters"
programmes.d: Explore with us how a manmade disaster could be as much destructive as some natural disaster.

programmes.t: Miracle Materials S1 - "From Wood to Bamboo"
programmes.d: Architects harness rapidly renewable resources like timber, transparent wood, bamboo, and mycelium fungi to construct future cities.

programmes.t: Engineering Reborn S1 - "Tate Modern, TWA Hotel, Tropical Island Resort"
programmes.d: A power station, airport terminal, and airship hangar undergo dramatic structural revamps into world-class facilities.

programmes.t: Engineering Reborn S1 - "St. Louis Aquarium, Museum of African Art, Television Centre"
programmes.d: A historic train station, grain silos, and broadcasting headquarters are transformed into state-of-the-art hubs.

programmes.t: Building to the Sky S1 - "Form Follows Function 1933 - 1972"
programmes.d: Post-war corporate growth drives architectural innovations in concrete and high-rise design led by visionary figures like Mies Van Der Rohe.

programmes.t: Journey to Planet Earth S2 - "Future Conditional"
programmes.d: Looks at the spread of air and water pollution and how contamination in one area can affect people and animals living thousands of miles away.

programmes.t: Journey to Planet Earth S2 - "Hot Zones"
programmes.d: Examines how recent trends in globalization and the altering of ecosystems have led to dramatic increases in the spread of infectious diseases.

programmes.t: Journey to Planet Earth S2 - "Seas of Grass"
programmes.d: Shows the devastating environmental, political, and economic effects of the degradation of the world's grasslands.

programmes.t: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Future of Living Part 1"
programmes.d: Learn about future of living at the International Furniture Fair Cologne: vertical cities, new housing concepts & home innovations.

programmes.t: Sci Q S1 - "Test Your Science Genius"
programmes.d: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. Do flying squirrels really fly? What caused the extinction of the dinosaur? How old are the fossils found at the bottom of the Grand Canyon?

programmes.t: Sci Q S1 - "What’s Your Science IQ?"
programmes.d: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. How smart is the modern-day robot? How come Earth has a protective atmosphere? Why does the U.S. have more tornadoes than anywhere else in the world?

programmes.t: Sci Q S1 - "Discover your Science Intelligence"
programmes.d: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. Is it true that we only use 10% of our brain? Did Mars used to have an ocean? How much longer will we be able to live on fossil fuels?

programmes.t: Sci Q S1 - "Measure Your Sci Q"
programmes.d: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. What causes a lightning strike? Where in our solar system is the asteroid belt? What’s the difference between a stalagmite and a stalactite?

programmes.t: Bridging the Expanse S1 - "The Wonder of Bridges"
programmes.d: Pre-industrial societies around the world construct early bridges, reflecting evolving technologies and expanding human exploration.

programmes.t: Bright Now S1 - "Sailing to the Stars"
programmes.d: Solar sails, the latest in space travel technology, could one day help us reach nearby stars. Follow the exciting missions laying the ground towards a new form of space exploration.

programmes.t: Bright Now S1 - "Bear Cub Rescue"
programmes.d: Growing up in Montana, Casey Anderson come to love and appreciate wild animals at a very young age. He found a particular kinship with bears. One day he was faced with a fateful decision, leave and orphaned grizzly cub to die in the wild or save it.

programmes.t: Bright Now S1 - "Search for Japan's Lost Supersub"
programmes.d: The I-400 was one of the Imperial Japanese Navy's Sen Toku-class submarines, which were the largest submarines ever built before the age of nuclear-powered subs.

programmes.t: Bright Now S1 - "Path to the Pros"
programmes.d: What does it take to become a professional tennis player? Both on and off the court preparations help build the streght of character and focused mind to take on the challenges of a sport that demands precision and superior athleticism.

programmes.t: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Fascinating Future Of Growing Food"
programmes.d: Host Chuck Pell introduces us to developments going on in labs, research farms, plant genetics and something called aquaponics to enhance our ability to grow food.

programmes.t: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Future Of Water"
programmes.d: Host Chuck Pell explores how drought stricken southern California is using millions of plastic balls to conserve water.

programmes.t: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Robot Revolution"
programmes.d: Host Chuck Pell gets introduced to a 200 pound robot that’s almost as graceful as a dancer.

programmes.t: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Future Of Robot Makers And Innovators"
programmes.d: Host Chuck Pell also pays a visit to a shop that builds customized robots.

programmes.t: Proof of Concept S1 - "Conceiving Consciousness"
programmes.d: Simone Giertz, Reggie Watts, & Naomi Fitter, join Dianna for an exploration of what consciousness is & whether it can ever be understood. Also, a robot tells jokes.

programmes.t: Proof of Concept S1 - "Randomness & Probability"
programmes.d: Comedian Maz Jobrani & Blackjack legend Mike Aponte play the odds, meanwhile, Dianna finds order in chaos, and just maybe hacks the stock market.

programmes.t: Proof of Concept S1 - "Truth & Logical Paradox"
programmes.d: Dianna dives through the looking glass in this paradoxical exploration of truth itself, where the left could be right, & right might be wrong. w/ guest Zach Pincince.

programmes.t: Proof of Concept S1 - "The Infinite"
programmes.d: Kyle Hill & Eugenia Cheng join the show to prove there is more than one infinity, that infinity is hidden all around us, & that we might actually be infinite ourselves.
